critic_reason: Coinbase's quoted payment share supports the stated concentration of facilitator payments.

claim_text: The Vybe GitHub org has 18 public non-fork repos. The sources name no founders or contributor counts, so team size and composition are unknown.

claim_text: The service runtime is closed source and not in the repository; only the buyer side is public, so the delivery backend cannot be verified from the sources.
quote_or_metric: The service runtime is not in this repository; this is the complete public
critic_reason: The quote establishes that the runtime is absent from this repository but does not establish that it is closed source or unverifiable elsewhere.

claim_text: In the earlier ai-agent-crew repo, whoabuddy has 262 commits, the most of any listed contributor. Only handles are given, not names.
critic_reason: The quote supports whoabuddy's commit count but contains neither contributor comparisons nor evidence about the other contributors' names.

claim_text: A testimonial attributed to Superteam Canada says it used the Vybe API for historical wallet and token data. This is a named but unverified API user.
quote_or_metric: Vybe gave us complete historical data for wallets and tokens we couldn't find anywhere else.
critic_reason: The quote supports reported use of historical wallet and token data but contains no attribution to Superteam Canada.

claim_text: A second human contributor, jmborden1112-beep, has 34 commits in the main integrations repo.
critic_reason: The receipt supports the account's commit count, but a GitHub User account does not establish a distinct second human.

claim_text: In x402 market structure, Coinbase handles 68.2% of payments. Sera does not appear as a facilitator in the market-structure data, so any x402 exposure is via services in the companion repo, not facilitation.
quote_or_metric: coinbase: 2,342,973 payments (68.2% of payments), 525,020 USD (35.2% of volume)
critic_reason: The quote supports Coinbase's payment share but establishes neither Sera's absence from the broader market nor an exclusive channel for its x402 exposure.

claim_text: Josh-sera is the top contributor to sera-mcp with 11 commits. Five other contributors are listed after him, so there is some outside contribution, but the build looks concentrated in one person.
critic_reason: The quote supports Josh-sera's commit count but does not establish contributor ranking, other contributors, outside affiliation or concentration of work.

claim_text: Ausca builds on the x402 payment standard, where the Coinbase facilitator alone processed 2,342,973 payments in the latest reported window.
quote_or_metric: coinbase: 2,342,973 payments (68.2% of payments), 525,020 USD (35.2% of volume)
critic_reason: The receipt supports Coinbase's payment count but does not establish Ausca's use of x402 or identify the reporting window.

claim_text: Distribution work is visible: an MCP registry listing, a Smithery listing and installable agent skills for each of five services.
critic_reason: The command supports a skills installation path but does not establish registry listings, service coverage or the number of skills.

claim_text: Some product features are not yet shipped: the website marks verified approver, audit trail CSV export and reconciliation as rolling out.
critic_reason: The feature label alone establishes neither rollout status nor the shipping status of any listed capability.

claim_text: No funding, round, token or YC evidence was found, and the repo is listed alongside several other open-source projects (RWA platform, MCP scanner, Postflight), so focus is split.
critic_reason: The quoted product name establishes neither funding status nor the other projects or any split in team focus.
